comparison.objective: Dispense exactly ten pre-counted tablets from a tray trough into a held vial while leaving six others behind.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a vial aloft and tip a granular tray without spilling or mixing tablets.
comparison.success_condition: All ten counted tablets enter the raised vial, all six others remain in the counting area, and none spill.
comparison.reason: Granular pouring and count preservation test a different mechanism and outcome from damper unlocking, fine rotary adjustment, relocking, and stopping-response validation.
